text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, can you believe it's this late
already? We need to start heading
back or
we'll miss curfew.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Time to go. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, y-yeah.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, look at Rob Roy. She must have
really tired herself out today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Her brain's been doin' double time all
day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Well, Bourbon. What are your plans for
the rest of the evening?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will compile today's data and reconfigure
the party plans. Then I will
complete the
rest of my task list for today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...By yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's what my role entails.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Here we are. Good night, you two.

text_block_list.name: Rice & Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Good... night...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bourbon! G-guess what! You know the
decorations we were
supposed to finish
tomorrow? We got through them all today!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
You've been working really late on party
stuff, right? Since we're free
now, we were
thinking we could help with your tasks.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, that will not be necessary. Please use
the extra time in your
schedule to rest.
You did your tasks, and I must do mine.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Wait, but...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: We know you can do everything all alone, but you don't have to push yourself that hard. Let's all work together to make the party a hit!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If I may, I'd say that escaping the haunted
house is a mission for all
five of us.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...It's my responsibility to complete the
specific objectives in my task
list.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, the overarching mission
"Cross-Dorm Halloween Party" is
the
responsibility of all participants...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then again, I've already turned so many
offers down...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy was scared she was being a
bother, but she still... She was
brave and
helped me, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Maybe if I "transformed" too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sorry for barging in like this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Rice? It's almost time for lights-out!
You're supposed to be in
your own dorm.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I know, but! I, um! I... Ummm—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
P-please let me borrow my costume! I
need it so I can...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So I can help Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Rice.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaall right, I'll fend off Fuji and Hishiama
for ya. Gimme a sec, and
then I'll go with—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Er, scratch that. Ya got the guts to make
it this far—you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Rice, I'm sure you'll make it work. I'll grab
the costume for ya, so
couldja hold tight a
minute?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Flower confirmed to be asleep. I will
relocate operations to another
room.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Remaining tasks: write event proposal,
complete today's decoration
goals for
anyone unable to finish, cut fabric
supplies—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to my kingdom of the night! I-I'm
a vampire, and...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to... turn you into my vampire
friend!
